scope: Synthetic input discrimination only; no bank data, notes or dataset splits
text_gate: All 36 actual text responses correct, strict expected format, normal stop, verified rendering and no technical errors. Otherwise no images. Truncation means semantics NOT_ASSESSED, not model incapacity.
image_gate: Only after text gate: original generated four-frame EXIT/ENTER/STAY, both label maps, bare/JSON/schema, 18 calls. Same scoring; no bank/action/legal transfer claim.
supervisor_scope: One compound quality assertion evaluated after actual calls; monitor completed_cases is NOT call count. Actual completed calls are separately aggregated. Technical errors keep assertion NOT_ASSESSED and partial counts.
stop: No retry, adaptive prompt edits, extra seeds, TRAIN/TUNE/HOLDOUT, private answer reads or second GPU worker. Preserve frozen baseline.
not_identified: Bare versus JSON changes requested output format; JSON plain versus schema isolates response_format
Successful template presence does not prove the numerical backend uses input
A tiny synthetic control is not human-action, bank-event, new-camera or legal validation
